news.title: JLHL: BKC Hospital Lease Will Support Future Expansion And Upside Potential
news.body: Analysts have raised their price target on Jupiter Life Line Hospitals slightly from ₹1,599 to ₹1,609, citing updated assumptions around discount rates, revenue growth, profit margins and future P/E that together suggest a modestly higher assessed fair value. What's in the News Jupiter Life Line Hospitals received acceptance from the Mumbai Metropolitan Region Development Authority for the allotment of land on a long term lease for hospital development at Bandra Kurla Complex, Maharashtra (Key Developments).

news.title: JLHL: BKC Land Lease Will Support New Long Term Hospital Expansion
news.body: Analysts have slightly raised their price target on Jupiter Life Line Hospitals from ₹1,589.80 to ₹1,599.00, citing updated assumptions around profit margins and valuation multiples. What's in the News Jupiter Life Line Hospitals received a letter from the Mumbai Metropolitan Region Development Authority confirming acceptance of its tender for an 80 year land lease at plot SF5 in the GTxT Block of Bandra Kurla Complex, Maharashtra (Key Developments).

news.title: JLHL: BKC Land Lease For New Hospital Will Support Bullish Outlook
news.body: Analysts have kept their price target for Jupiter Life Line Hospitals unchanged at about ₹1,590, citing broadly stable assumptions on the discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin and future P/E multiples. What's in the News Letter received from Mumbai Metropolitan Region Development Authority accepting Jupiter Life Line Hospitals' tender for an 80 year land lease at Bandra Kurla Complex in Maharashtra, covering approximately 10,026.44 sqm (Key Developments).

news.title: JLHL: January 2026 Results Review Will Support Bullish Long Term Outlook
news.body: Analysts have trimmed their price target for Jupiter Life Line Hospitals from ₹1,614.80 to ₹1,589.80, reflecting updated assumptions for revenue growth, profit margin and future P/E, while keeping the discount rate unchanged. What's in the News Jupiter Life Line Hospitals has scheduled a board meeting for January 30, 2026, to review and approve unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter ended December 31, 2025 (Key Developments).

news.title: JLHL: January 2026 Board Review Will Support Bullish Long Term Outlook
news.body: Analysts have maintained their fair value estimate for Jupiter Life Line Hospitals at ₹1,614.80, citing unchanged assumptions around discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin and future P/E as the basis for keeping their price target at the same level. What's in the News A board meeting is scheduled on January 30, 2026 to consider, review, and approve unaudited standalone financial results for the quarter and nine months ended December 31, 2025 (Key Developments).

news.title: Insufficient new directors
news.body: There is 1 new director who has joined the board in the last 3 years. The company's board is composed of: 1 new director. 3 experienced directors. 3 highly experienced directors. Non-Executive Independent Director Amar Manjrekar was the last director to join the board, commencing their role in 2024. The company’s insufficient board refreshment is considered a risk according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model.

news.title: JLHL: Upcoming Board Review Will Confirm Bullish Long Term Margin Outlook
news.body: Analysts have left their price target for Jupiter Life Line Hospitals unchanged at ₹1,614.80, citing consistent assumptions on discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin and future P/E that continue to support this valuation. What's in the News A board meeting is scheduled for January 30, 2026, to consider, review, and approve unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter ended December 31, 2025.

news.title: JLHL: Upcoming Results Will Clarify Margin Pressures Behind Bullish View
news.body: Analysts have trimmed their price target for Jupiter Life Line Hospitals to ₹1,614.80 from ₹1,754.80, reflecting updated views that combine slightly higher revenue growth assumptions with lower profit margins and a reduced future P/E multiple. What's in the News A board meeting is scheduled on January 30, 2026 to consider, review and approve unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and nine months ended December 31, 2025 (company filing).

news.title: Price target decreased by 10% to ₹1,615
news.body: Down from ₹1,801, the current price target is an average from 5 analysts. New target price is 32% above last closing price of ₹1,226. Stock is down 26% over the past year. The company is forecast to post earnings per share of ₹29.00 for next year compared to ₹29.51 last year.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹6.49 (vs ₹8.01 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹6.49 (down from ₹8.01 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹3.65b (up 14% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹425.5m (down 19% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 12% (down from 16% in 3Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Revenue is forecast to grow 17% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 20% growth forecast for the Healthcare industry in India.
